assignment: Write a decision memo to the treasurer. Select a bridge action, justify the six-week cash floor and give a trigger for revisiting the plan.
source: The opening balance is $110k. Receipts and outflows through week six are $40k and $105k. Policy requires at least $60k at week six. A $20k supplier deferral costs $1k now. A $30k credit draw costs $2k now and matures in week eight. A $25k expected customer payment arrives in week seven and may slip.

criteria.full: Computes $45k before action and a $15k shortfall. Keeps the week-seven receipt outside the horizon.
criteria.partial: Identifies a shortfall but omits its size or timing.

criteria.full: Compares $64k after deferral with $73k after drawing, including fees and later obligations.
criteria.partial: Names both levers but prices only one or ignores repayment.

criteria.full: Chooses a feasible bridge and explains the trade between cash headroom and the cost or supplier relationship.
criteria.partial: Picks a feasible option with only generic justification.

criteria.full: Gives an owner, a time and a measurable trigger tied to the uncertain receipt or an earlier cash floor.
criteria.partial: Identifies the receipt risk without a concrete review trigger.
